chunks: Say: 'I am commanded to worship God, making the religion exclusive for Him.'
ai.seo_question: What does it mean to worship God with exclusive devotion according to Surah Az-Zumar?
ai.summary: This verse, revealed in Surah Az-Zumar, underscores the Prophet's (peace be upon him) adherence to divine command in purifying worship from all forms of shirk, a central theme in Shia theology regarding the purity of intention (ikhlas). It serves as a foundational proof for the necessity of directing all acts of devotion solely to Allah, reflecting the concept of Tawhid al-Uluhiyyah. The emphasis on 'being commanded' highlights the Prophet's role as the perfect exemplar of sincere servitude.
